hard_rules: No gate implies a later gate.
No named product package is accepted without the exact binary and SHA-256.
No Drive custody claim is accepted without download and equality readback.
No credential or protected raw source is serialized into public or ordinary control surfaces.
Corrections append and supersession remains explicit.
Failing SKUs are quarantined independently unless a shared dependency is proven unsafe.
New rotation improvements produce additive prior-rotation backfill audits.
